summary: Current venue is the new Ryan Field (opened 2026). Best photo is a lower-bowl game-day sideline view; no upper-deck or night photo yet.

files.note: CURRENT HOME VENUE: the new Ryan Field (opened Sept 2026; Northwestern played 2024-25 at Martin Stadium). Lower-bowl west sideline view across the field to the east stands, Oct 2026 homecoming game; field rows ~990-1620 of 1800 (55-90%), three tiers of stands ~0-55% (no sky), team bench and fans in the bottom ~10%. Low viewpoint: field sits low

closest_misses.why: Same game from the north end zone, low; field rows ~55-100%, goalpost cuts the right side
